newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Shoredits shares suspended on JSE.
newsitem.headline: Shoredits shares suspended on JSE.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) announced on Friday that it had suspended Shoredits Holdings Ltd's shares while it clarified whether the company's latest results had been audited or not.
It said that the company had stated that its results for the year to June 30, announced on Friday, had been audited.
"However, the JSE has been advised by the auditors of Shoredits that the results have not yet been audited," the exchange said in a statement.
To protect shareholders' interest, the exchange had suspended Shoredits shares until the matter had been clarified.

Shoredits was previously informed that if it did not distribute its audited annual financial statement or publish its preliminary report by October 16, the JSE would publish a press announcement that this had not occurred and that its listing was under threat of suspension and possible termination.
